query: What is the required operator action for a Burn anomaly on the mix cooker?
ground_truth: Machine 3 (mix cooker) - Burn affects temperature. Burn indicates overheating severe enough to scorch the product or damage the heated surface. Action: clear the anomaly, stop the machine, then start it back to operation. Continued operation can compromise product quality and damage the vessel surface.

query: How do I clear a blade jam on the mixer?
ground_truth: Machine 2 (mixer) - Blade Jam affects rpm and torque_nm. It means the mixing assembly is obstructed. Action: stop the machine, then start it and verify normal blade movement resumed. Do not continue if abnormal torque or vibration is still present after restart.

query: Mixer is overheating, what should I do?
ground_truth: Machine 2 (mixer) - Overheating affects temperature, usually from excessive load, friction or poor cooling. Action: clear the anomaly, stop the machine immediately, then start back to operation. Do not restart unless instructed by maintenance or supervision.

query: Pasteurizer pressure drop steps to recover
ground_truth: Machine 4 (pasteurizer) - Pressure Drop affects pressure (leakage, restriction, or pump inefficiency). Action: clear the anomaly, stop the machine, start the machine. If the condition returns, escalate for maintenance inspection.

query: Pasteurizer overheating fix
ground_truth: Machine 4 (pasteurizer) - Overheating affects temperature above safe control range. Action: clear the anomaly, stop the machine, start back to operation. Product integrity may be affected if the cycle continues above allowed temperature.

query: Homogenizer valve failure handling
ground_truth: Machine 5 (homogenizer) - Valve Failure affects pressure_bar and particle_size_um, disrupting pressure regulation and causing non-uniform texture. Action: clear, stop, start. Do not continue production if abnormal pressure persists.

query: Aging tank temperature rise procedure
ground_truth: Machine 6 (aging tank) - Temperature Rise affects temperature, a loss of cooling during aging. Action: clear, stop, start back to operation. Do not continue the batch if product temperature cannot be maintained.

query: Aging tank overflow, what now?
ground_truth: Machine 6 (aging tank) - Overflow affects level_pct, spill and contamination risk. Action: clear, stop, start back. Verify surrounding surfaces and product handling areas before restarting adjacent operations.

query: Blast freezer compressor failed
ground_truth: Machine 7 (blast freezer) - Compressor Failure affects temperature and air_speed_ms, reducing cooling and airflow. Action: clear, stop, start. If freezing does not recover promptly, isolate the unit and escalate.

query: Storage freezer door stuck what to do
ground_truth: Machine 8 (storage freezer) - Door Stuck affects door_open and temperature, allowing unwanted temperature increase. Action: clear, stop, start. Minimize door openings until fully resolved.

query: Cold room defrost failure operator action
ground_truth: Machine 9 (cold room) - Defrost Failure affects temperature, causing ice accumulation and reduced heat exchange. Action: clear, stop, start. Repeated failures mean inspect before continued loading.

query: Cold room overload remediation
ground_truth: Machine 9 (cold room) - Overload affects occupancy_pct; the room holds too much product, restricting airflow. Action: clear, stop, start back. Arrange product to allow adequate air circulation.

query: Batch freezer motor failure steps
ground_truth: Machine 10 (batch freezer) - Motor Failure affects dasher_rpm, preventing dasher rotation. Action: clear, stop, start. If the motor fails again after restart, remove the unit from production.

query: Batch freezer freeze lock recovery
ground_truth: Machine 10 (batch freezer) - Freeze Lock affects temperature; unit is too cold or restricted by frozen product. Action: clear, stop, start. Do not force operation if the chamber stays locked or abnormal resistance remains.

query: Scale showing drift, fix it
ground_truth: Machine 1 (scale) - Drift affects weight_kg and stability, causing under/overfilling and unstable weighing. Action: clear, stop, start and confirm reading is stable. If instability remains, remove the scale and inspect calibration/alignment.

query: Mix cooker stall, agitator stopped

query: How should I make a Stracciatella?
ground_truth: White vanilla base with dark chocolate/couverture. At the end of freezing, drizzle tempered or fluid chocolate so it fractures into shards in the cold mass. Differs from chocolate chip because shards are irregular, thin and created in situ.

query: How do I prepare Pistacchio gelato?
ground_truth: White base with pure pistachio paste and optional salt correction. Warm and emulsify the paste into the base, then mature and freeze. Greener, more resinous and savory than hazelnut; color depends on raw paste quality.

query: Raw materials for Nocciola
ground_truth: White base, pure hazelnut paste, optional roasted hazelnut garnish. Warm paste, emulsify, mature, freeze. Round, toasted, sweet-fat; softer/more confectionary than pistachio.

query: How is Crema different from Vanilla?
ground_truth: Crema uses base gialla with egg yolks and vanilla, cooked as custard; richer and warmer with stronger egg notes. Vanilla in white base reads fresh and lifted, in yellow base custard-forward.

query: Lemon sorbetto process
ground_truth: Sorbetto base with water, lemon juice, zest, sugar blend, fruit stabilizer. Use zest for aroma then add juice cold/late and freeze fast. High acidity, cleanest fruit flavor, no pulp body unless left in.

query: How to make dark chocolate gelato (cioccolato fondente)?
ground_truth: White base adapted with cocoa and/or dark chocolate, sugar rebalanced, possibly less dairy fat. Disperse cocoa fully, melt chocolate into the hot/warm phase, rebalance sweetness and solids. More intense and drier than milk chocolate.

query: Difference between caramel and dulce de leche flavor
ground_truth: Caramel uses dry caramel or sauce on white base, lower dairy-caramel depth, darker bitter edge. Dulce de leche on milk base is more milky and jam-like with richer solids.

query: How to make zabaione flavor and watch out for what?
ground_truth: Yellow base, yolks, Marsala. Cook custard first, add alcohol with restraint and rebalance softness because alcohol depresses freezing point. Overusing alcohol makes it softer and unstable.

query: Strawberry gelato tips
ground_truth: Fruit sorbetto or milk-fruit base with strawberry puree; use ripe puree, filter seeds if desired, rebalance for fruit water. Low acidity, high aroma volatility, tastes flat if fruit quality is weak.

query: Mango vs many berries body difference
ground_truth: Mango (sorbetto/yogurt-gelato base, ripe puree) has naturally fuller body because puree carries more solids; avoid over-dilution.

query: Fior di latte description
ground_truth: Base bianca with whole milk, cream, sucrose, dextrose/glucose solids, skim milk powder, stabilizer. Build/mature a clean white base, modest overrun, no heavy vanilla. Benchmark dairy flavor, cleaner than vanilla, more transparent than crema.

query: Why use mandorla (almond) over hazelnut
ground_truth: Almond on white/sorbetto base with delicate roast is cleaner, lighter and more floral than hazelnut, avoiding overpowering dairy aromas.

query: Caffè flavor main risk
ground_truth: Aroma loss if overheated; infuse or add concentrated coffee to mature base and balance bitterness with sugar. Less fatty than nut flavors.

query: Yogurt gelato profile
ground_truth: Milk base with yogurt or yogurt powder; preserve tang, limit whey separation. Acid-tang, lighter than crema or fior di latte.

query: Liquorice flavor caution
ground_truth: Highly aromatic specialty flavor; dose carefully because it dominates quickly and often needs salt balancing. Far less forgiving than vanilla or coffee.

query: Noce (walnut) handling
ground_truth: White base with walnut paste/praliné; use carefully as oxidation bitterness rises quickly. More tannic and bitter than hazelnut or almond.

query: Coconut flavor balance
ground_truth: Milk or vegan base with coconut milk/cream/flakes; balance coconut fat and choose creamy vs fibrous texture. Aroma strong but body light if coconut solids low.

query: Raspberry vs strawberry
ground_truth: Raspberry (sorbetto, filter seeds, balance acidity) is sharper and more aromatic than strawberry.

query: Orange vs lemon sorbetto
ground_truth: Orange is rounder, sweeter, less sharp; use zest moderately to avoid bitterness; lower acidity than lemon.

query: Pineapple texture concern
ground_truth: More tropical-acid than mango; can feel thinner if solids low; balance acidity and fiber, avoid cooked flavor for fresh profile.

query: Mint flavor advice
ground_truth: White base, mint infusion/extract, optional chocolate shards; prefer cool-phase additions for freshness. Aromatic not structural, easy to over-flavor.

query: Banana gelato notes
ground_truth: Milk-fruit or sorbetto style with banana puree; use anti-browning and moderate sugar since ripe banana is sweet. Heavier and more naturally creamy than most fruit flavors.

query: Cheesecake / ricotta / mascarpone family
ground_truth: White/lightly yellow base with fresh cheese; add once base is smooth, manage fat/solids. Richer and denser than yogurt; pairs with ripples/biscuits.

query: Amaretto flavor texture risks
ground_truth: Milk base, almond flavor, amaretto/amaretti; add alcohol or biscuits late and guard against soggy inclusions. Between nut and bakery families.

query: Moka / cappuccino vs caffè
ground_truth: Moka uses gentler coffee intensity and emphasizes dairy roundness; softer and more dessert-like than straight caffè.

query: Milk chocolate / gianduia profile
ground_truth: Milk base with milk chocolate; softer chocolate profile, rounder dairy finish; sweeter, more lactonic and less bitter than dark chocolate.

query: Blackberry / blueberry sorbetto note
ground_truth: Sorbetto base with berry puree, filter and protect color; color-rich but less aromatic than raspberry.

query: Peach / apricot flavor character
ground_truth: Sorbetto base, stone-fruit puree, control oxidation/browning; softer aromatic profile than citrus or berry families.

query: Fig/grape/wine seasonal flavor risk
ground_truth: Fruit or milk base; manage sugar and alcohol; often seasonal with higher softness risk if syrupy reductions are overused.

query: What base does pistachio use, white or yellow?
ground_truth: White base.

query: Which flavor is the dairy benchmark, fior di latte or vanilla?
ground_truth: Fior di latte is the benchmark dairy flavor, cleaner and less aromatic than vanilla.

query: Why does zabaione need a softer freeze balance?
ground_truth: Alcohol (Marsala) strongly depresses the freezing point, so sweetness/softness must be rebalanced.

query: What is overrun?
ground_truth: Overrun is the percentage increase in volume from air incorporation. It affects density, whiteness, texture, economics and melt; premium products run lower overrun than economy.

query: What controls overrun?
ground_truth: Stable mix composition, freezer pressure, dasher speed, air injection, draw temperature, and weight verification.

query: What is the preferred one-way plant flow?
ground_truth: Receiving -> storage -> batching -> heat treatment -> ageing -> freezing/forming -> hardening -> packaging -> cold storage -> dispatch.

query: Name the hygienic zone categories
ground_truth: Low-risk (receiving, workshops, packaging/dry stores), medium-care (pre-pasteurization mixing, utilities), and high-hygiene (everything from ageing outlet onward, freezers, fillers, extrusion, sauce dosing, exposed product).

query: Core job of the pasteurizer and risk if off-target
ground_truth: Thermal treatment; off-target creates safety and shelf-life risk.

query: What does the homogenizer do?
ground_truth: Fat droplet reduction; if off-target, texture and body inconsistency.

query: Aging tank purpose
ground_truth: Cold maturation; off-target gives poor whipping and weak structure.

query: Continuous freezer role
ground_truth: Partial freezing plus aeration; off-target causes wrong overrun, density or draw behavior.

query: Hardening tunnel function
ground_truth: Rapid structural locking; off-target causes crystal growth and shape loss.

query: Cold store function
ground_truth: Preservation of finished quality; off-target leads to heat shock and reduced shelf life.

query: Most sensitive hygiene period in the plant
ground_truth: Post-pasteurization exposure is the most sensitive hygiene period.

query: What controls ice crystal size and body?
ground_truth: Draw temperature and hardening speed directly affect ice crystal size and final body.

query: Why is inclusion addition critical?
ground_truth: It is both a quality-control and allergen-control breakpoint.

query: Common cause of severe failures besides pasteurization?
ground_truth: Post-pasteurization contamination from poor zoning, sanitation, condensate, environmental harborage, allergen mix-ups, or label control failures.

query: Root cause and fix for sandy defect
ground_truth: Caused by lactose crystallization from high MSNF or storage abuse; rebalance solids and improve temperature stability.

query: Cause and fix for icy/coarse texture
ground_truth: Slow hardening, heat shock, weak stabilizer, poor storage; fix with faster hardening, cold-chain discipline, formulation review.

query: Weak body / fast melt mitigation
ground_truth: Caused by low solids, poor emulsification, weak overrun control; review formulation and freezer settings.

query: Gummy body cause
ground_truth: Overstabilization or hydration imbalance; reduce or rebalance the stabilizer system.

query: Freezer instability remedies
ground_truth: From poor solids, barrel icing, mechanical wear; fix via maintenance, formulation review, draw-temperature control.

query: What standards underpin a global ice cream compliance system?
ground_truth: Codex Alimentarius, Codex hygiene + HACCP, ISO 22000, GMP/GHP, GFSI-recognized schemes, and national frozen-dessert identity/labeling laws.

query: What are prerequisite programs plus HACCP for?
ground_truth: Food safety; pasteurization protects the mix but PRPs and product-specific HACCP control contamination and severe failures.

query: List common allergens handled in ice cream plants
ground_truth: Milk, nuts, peanuts, soy, gluten-containing inclusions, egg-containing bakery pieces, and market-specific allergens.

query: How is allergen control achieved?
ground_truth: Supplier management, sequencing or dedicated lines, verified changeover cleaning, label verification, utensil segregation, controlled rework, and line-release checks.

query: Why is chocolate operationally harder than vanilla?
ground_truth: Cocoa solids and higher flavor load raise viscosity, darker carryover risk, and settling if formulation is weak.

query: What does CIP do and what if poor?
ground_truth: Automated cleaning of lines, tanks, freezers, pasteurizers; poor CIP causes biofilm, chemical residues, incomplete cleaning, flavor carryover and freezer instability.

query: Sorbet vs gelato fat phase
ground_truth: Sorbet/water ice has no fat phase; texture relies on sugar balance and stabilizer system.

query: Tests to confirm body and yield
ground_truth: Physical tests: overrun, density, hardness, fill weight, dimensions, coating pick-up.

query: Microbiological tests purpose
ground_truth: Aerobic plate count, coliform indicators, yeasts/molds, pathogen testing verify hygiene, ingredient quality and post-pasteurization control.

query: Why treat refrigeration as a quality system?
ground_truth: Insufficient pull-down or unstable temperature causes heat shock; refrigeration is a product-quality system, not only a utilities cost center.

query: What does the historian/SCADA prevent?
ground_truth: Undetected drift, poor records, weak investigation; enables recipe control, alarms, trends, traceability.

query: Ageing tank temperature range
ground_truth: About 2-5 C, with gentle agitation 5-20 rpm and level 20-95%.

query: Pasteurizer normal temperature range
ground_truth: 72-85 C, with pressure 2-3.5 and flow 100-200.

query: Storage freezer normal temperature
ground_truth: -25 to -18 C with humidity 60-85% and door closed.

query: Mixer normal rpm range
ground_truth: 60-300 rpm, temperature 20-45, torque 5-50 Nm.

query: What functions does the minor ingredient room serve?
ground_truth: Controlled dosing of flavors, colors, emulsifiers, vitamins with access control, weighing accuracy and allergen management.

query: Why is hot water/boiler important?
ground_truth: Supports pasteurization and CIP; if poor, ineffective heating and cleaning.

query: Role of homogenizer in body
ground_truth: Reduces fat globule size, stabilizes emulsion, improves smoothness, body, meltdown.

query: What hardening tunnel risk if insufficient?
ground_truth: Crystal growth and shape loss; improve tunnel performance and transfer timing for novelty deformation.

query: Why is packaging a control point beyond sealing?
ground_truth: It is also a traceability, legal, and foreign-body control point with metal detection/X-ray and coding.

query: Label or allergen recall causes and prevention
ground_truth: Wrong film/lid, poor line clearance, ERP mismatch; prevent with barcode vision checks, reconciliation, independent verification.

query: Cold-store shrinkage cause and fix
ground_truth: Package leak, temperature cycling, weak structure; fix with seal verification, tighter cold chain, formulation adjustment.

query: Why does fruit flavor micro load matter?
ground_truth: Inclusions' micro load must be controlled and acidity may affect body; fruit preps differ in acidity, water activity and natural color.

query: What is the benchmark flavor for evaluating base quality?
ground_truth: Vanilla — benchmark for evaluating base quality and off-flavors.

query: What does ageing do for the mix?
ground_truth: Holds mix cold so fat crystallizes and stabilizers hydrate, improving whipping and structure.

query: Why FIFO/FEFO in raw storage?
ground_truth: Manage chilled liquids, powders, fats, inclusions with allergen segregation and humidity control for powders.

query: Premium ripple product requirement
ground_truth: Precise feeder sync and higher visual quality standard for visible sauces and larger inclusions.

query: Plant-based dessert operational issues
ground_truth: Alternative proteins/fats: different emulsification, flavor masking, allergen labeling.

query: What raw material defines pistachio color?

query: Why protect raspberry color via filter?

query: Vanilla in white vs yellow base
ground_truth: White base reads fresh/lifted; yellow base reads custard-forward.

query: Coconut body when low solids

query: Why walnut bitterness rises?
ground_truth: Oxidation bitterness rises quickly in walnut systems, more tannic than hazelnut/almond.

query: Stracciatella vs chocolate chip
ground_truth: Stracciatella shards are irregular, thin, created in situ; chocolate chip is pre-formed.
